redFindings.title: Data health: freshness-fashionphile is RED
redFindings.body:
Fashionphile data is 3.8 days old but its schedule promises a refresh every 0.125 day(s), so the capture likely stopped running.

Current value: 3.8 day(s) since the newest listing observation

redFindings.title: Data health: contamination-misattach is RED
redFindings.body:
47 accessories (card holders, pouches, shoes) landed on a real bag's variant in the last week, which is exactly what put wrong items on the deals rail; 174 more look like a different-model bag and want a manual review.

Current value: 47 accessory + 174 wrong-model (review) of 35664 recent bag-variant rows
Suggested action: Run supabase/ingest/detect-listing-discrepancies.ts (dry run to review, --write to re-point the accessories, --tag to label), and check why the ingest match let them onto a bag variant.
Report: reports/data-health/2026-07-13.md

redFindings.title: Data health: contamination-size is RED
redFindings.body:
816 listings captured in the last week state a size that differs from the variant they landed on (e.g. a mini on the Medium page), which unpopulates the size selector and skews same-size pricing.

Current value: 816 of 35664 recent sized rows sit on a different-size variant
Suggested action: Run supabase/ingest/resize-variants.ts (dry run, then --write) to re-point them, and check the load-prices size guard.
Report: reports/data-health/2026-07-13.md

redFindings.title: Data health: contamination-dupes is RED
redFindings.body:
1041 listings were written more than once for the same observation day, which contaminates medians until deduped.

Current value: 1041 duplicate (listing, day) rows
Suggested action: Inspect the newest loads; the loader should upsert on platform|listing_ref|price_type|observed_on.
Report: reports/data-health/2026-07-13.md
